faq.q: How do I get a Google review link?
faq.a: Open your Google Business Profile, select "Ask for reviews" and copy the short link. You can share it by text, email or a QR code.

faq.q: Can I offer a discount for a Google review?
faq.a: No. Incentivised reviews break Google's policies and UK consumer law. You can simply ask.

faq.q: How many Google reviews does a small business need?
faq.a: There is no set number, but more recent, detailed reviews than nearby competitors help. Aim for a steady few every month.

faq.q: Should I reply to negative reviews?
faq.a: Yes. Reply politely, acknowledge the issue and offer to sort it offline. It shows future customers you care.

faq.q: Can I remove a bad Google review?
faq.a: Only if it breaks Google's policies, for example fake or offensive content. You can report it from your Business Profile.
